name: Chintamani Fragment
effect: Once each turn, you may reveal the top card of the shared relic/event deck. You may leave it on top or place it on the bottom.

name: Reactor Core Fragment
effect: Your Specialist and Mystic each gain +1 ATK and ignore Leak damage.

name: Karpova's Black Key
effect: Your Leader and Common each gain +1 MOVE. Once each turn, one of them may move through 1 placed object or allied occupied tile, but must end on an empty tile.

name: Cosmonaut Helmet With A Second Shadow
effect: Your Mount and Warrior each gain +1 maximum HP and cannot be Marked.

name: Lead-Sealed Notebook
effect: Your Leader and Specialist each gain +1 RANGE.

name: Signal Array Turns
effect: If there is a placed object on the board, move one of your characters to an empty tile adjacent to it, if possible.

name: Reactor Prayer
effect: Choose one of your characters. It takes 1 damage and gains +1 character AP this turn.

name: Closed City Incident
effect: Place 2 Leak markers on different empty tiles within 2 of the center tile.

name: Seventeen Seconds
effect: This turn, each of your characters may move through 1 occupied tile or placed object, but must end on an empty tile.

name: Dream Monitors Synchronize
effect: You may swap the positions of the two Common characters if both are still on the board.

name: The Emerald Tablet
effect: Once each turn, after one of your characters gains Memory or starts movement adjacent to a placed object, choose one allied character within 2 tiles of a placed object. It gains Shield.

name: The Black Sarcophagus
effect: Your Warrior and Hero each gain +1 maximum HP. Once each round, when an enemy adjacent to one of your placed objects attacks, Mark that enemy after the attack resolves.

name: Tide-Sealed Archive
effect: At the start of your turn, every character adjacent to a placed object heals 1 HP, up to its maximum HP.

name: Seraphic Burial Veil
effect: Your Mystic gains +1 maximum HP. Once each round, when one of your allies would become Marked, you may prevent that Marked condition and give that ally Shield instead.

name: Basalt Ley Compass
effect: Your Common and Specialist each gain +1 MOVE. They may move through 1 allied placed object, but must end on an empty tile.

name: The Causeway Breathes
effect: Place 2 allied Stone markers on different empty tiles within 2 tiles of the center.

name: Black Water Remembers
effect: Choose a character on or adjacent to the center tile. Give it 1 Memory marker.

name: The Flood Reaches The Walls
effect: Each character on an outer edge tile becomes Marked.

name: The Drowned Seraph Speaks
effect: Your Mystic gains Shield. It also gains +1 ATK this turn. Shield remains until used.

name: Exiles Walk Beneath Egypt
effect: Move up to 2 allied characters that are adjacent to placed objects up to 1 tile each. They must end on empty tiles.
